name: mssql-readonly-mcp
description: Read one on-premises SQL Server database from Claude Code through the open-source mssql-readonly-mcp server: one plain SELECT per call, a login checked at startup, capped results, and a hash-chained audit file of every call.

connection_string.title: SQL Server connection string
connection_string.description: Connection string of the read-only login, for example Server=sql.example.local;Database=ExampleDb;User ID=mcp_reader;Password=... Claude Code keeps it outside settings.json; on Windows it is kept in plain text in .credentials.json in Claude Code's configuration folder (see the plugin README).

audit_log.title: Audit file path
audit_log.description: Absolute path of the audit file the server writes, for example C:/Users/you/mcp-audit/claude-code-plugin.jsonl or /home/you/mcp-audit/claude-code-plugin.jsonl. Use a folder only your account can read and write.
